description: Get the revocation list for offline proof validation. Returns a signed list of all revoked proof IDs. Reuse a fetched list for up to 5 minutes (its cache lifetime), then fetch it again to see new revocations; if you cannot, its signature stays verifiable offline for 1 hour.
name: list_revoked_proofs

has_more.description: True when a source hit its cap and the list may be incomplete — re-baseline and prefer the Token Status List, which never truncates

kid.description: Key id of the signing key, for JWKS lookup

signature.description: Signature over the payload for offline verification, in the algorithm of the key `kid` names (null when unsigned)

status_list_uri.description: The Token Status List endpoint — the scalable status channel that also covers SUSPENDED and can retract entries (an unsuspended bit flips back; a CRL entry cached by a `?since` poller cannot be unpublished)
